newsitem.title: USA: Dow Corning plans $7 mln expansion.
newsitem.headline: Dow Corning plans $7 mln expansion.

text.p: Dow Corning Corp said Monday it will conduct five expansion projects totalling $7 million at its advanced engineering materials site in Williams Township, Michigan.

"The construction projects add space for offices, labs, production capacity and equipment to support the rapidly growing customer needs for high-tech products and services of this facility," said James Sheroan, site manager, in a news release.
The facility produces a broad range of high technology products primarily for use in aerospace, automotive, electrical/electronic, and semiconductor industries, the company said.
